purpose: Durable cross-repo reference for xypes-identity platform orchestration, repo sequencing, and coordination handoffs.

whenToUpdate: When durable cross-repo sequencing, ownership, or rollout priorities change.
When repo-local work produces reusable platform coordination notes.
When platform orchestration behavior would otherwise need duplicate updates across multiple prompt or agent files.
doNotStore: Secrets, tokens, credentials, or personal data.
One-off chat recap without future planning value.

include: handoff notes another orchestrator should inherit

stableFocus: Engine first, admin second, sdk third, cross-repo validation last.
Treat the engine as the source of truth for authorization semantics, tenancy, scope, deny precedence, and audit shape.
Identity belongs to Supabase. Authorization belongs to the engine. Never blur the boundary.
Use direct delegation when repo-local orchestrators are available; otherwise return a concrete fallback plan.
coordinationNotes: When a contract or durable cross-repo rule changes, update the relevant file under ./shared/ before or alongside repo-local implementation.
If a task changes authorization semantics, tenancy, scope, deny precedence, audit shape, or decision contract, the engine must go first.
Do not let admin UX or SDK ergonomics override engine authorization, tenancy, or audit boundaries.
When runtime support is insufficient to delegate to a repo-local orchestrator, switch explicitly to fallback mode instead of pretending delegation succeeded.

Do not overstate completion: documented and tabletop-complete disaster recovery is not the same as a live restore drill, and SDK example entrypoints are not the same as a standalone reference consumer app.

Dependent platforms such as xypes-docman can already use resolve-session and authorize APIs, but production-grade provisioning still wants read/list semantics for applications, permissions, and role definitions.
validationDefaults: Prefer narrow per-repo validation commands over broad checklists.
Always finish with engine, admin, and sdk validation notes for cross-repo work.
Require contract tests for every external endpoint and semantics tests for every authorization rule.
Treat SLOs, rollout posture, and disaster recovery completion as requiring executable or recorded operational evidence, not documentation alone.

workingState.activeArea: Post-foundation platform coordination. Engine phases 1 through 5 are materially implemented; current cross-repo focus is admin governance surface, retry-safe dependent-platform provisioning, rollout controls, disaster recovery drill execution, and reference integrations.
notes: Platform orchestration should read the platform context, shared platform docs, and each touched repo's canonical agent-context file before making routing decisions.
Current stack direction: Node.js + TypeScript + Fastify + Supabase Auth + Postgres + Redis.
Use shared/ROADMAP.md as the durable source for current strengths, gaps, risks, and recommended next focus.

Near-term platform work should assume the engine is ahead of admin and rollout surfaces: prioritize operator experience, approval and audit workflows, DR execution evidence, dependent-platform provisioning reads, and end-to-end reference integrations over new authorization semantics unless a concrete gap requires engine-first work.
